cases.subject: Anatomy
cases.question: Why can radial nerve injury cause wrist drop?
expectedConcepts: The radial nerve supplies wrist extensors
Loss of wrist extension produces wrist drop
cases.expectedAnswer: Radial nerve injury denervates the wrist extensors, so wrist extension is lost and the hand drops into flexion.
cases.studentResponse: Radial nerve injury denervates the wrist extensors, so extension is lost and the hand falls into flexion.

sourceEvidence.content: The radial nerve supplies wrist extensors. Radial nerve injury can eliminate wrist extension and produce wrist drop.
